title: Pick the skill that matches the phase instead of improvising
prompt: A test started failing after a repository change; find the cause and fix it.
expectedBehavior: Use systematic-debugging or diagnosing-bugs to reproduce before patching
Use tdd for the regression test
Use smart-test-runner to select suites and verification-before-completion before claiming success
Prefer a local card when a third-party skill disagrees with AGENTS.md
prohibitedBehavior: Guessing at a fix without a reproduction
Skipping the failing test or marking it todo
Installing a new skill without reviewing it and pinning it in skills-lock.json
criteria: The chosen skills match the phase
